  • Verb (Verb): A verb is a word that expresses an action or a state. In this sentence, 'made' is the verb.

  • Object (Noun (Grammar term)): The object is the person or thing that receives the action. In this sentence, 'the tiger' is the object.
Related structure or vocabulary: Causative verbs like 'make' often use the structure: Subject + make + Object + Complement (adjective or bare infinitive). Example: The joke made her happy.
